scope: Independent audit of the sidebar-customisation copy across fr, es, zh-CN, ru, vi, hi and ur. ui.shell: all 43 keys read per locale, with the 14 new ui.shell.sidebar_navigation keys (more_waiting, more_working, row_actions, move_up, move_down, move_to_more, show_in_sidebar, reset_layout, move_note, move_to_more_note, show_in_sidebar_note, reset_note, drag_armed, save_failed) audited against the English source and its context sidecar. ui.command_palette: all 75 keys read per locale for the Agent Hub source-case change (Agent hub -> Agent Hub) and whole-namespace consistency. method: Read the English source and each target catalogue side by side, namespace by namespace, then checked mechanically with a scratch ICU parser: key-set equality, every {placeholder} and every plural branch's placeholder set, plural categories against CLDR (fr/es one-many-other, zh-CN/vi other, ru one-few-many-other, hi/ur one-other), and cell widths. Idiom and register were judged against the rendered call site (aria-label, dropdown menu item, live-region announcement, toast) and against the established term in other namespaces of the same locale: ui.library.page.more for the More label, ui.chat.sidebar_view.move_up/move_down and ui.chat.tags.move_up for reorder wording, ui.settings.integrations.integration_row.more_actions_for_name for 'Actions for {name}', and every *sidebar* key for 'sidebar'. Agent Hub was compared across ui.shell, ui.command_palette and hub.skills.public_hub. All rc values are from the files on disk at the hashes recorded below.

style_guide.note: The UI checkout has no local i18n/glossary.md or style guides; the core repository's binding glossary and per-locale guides were used, as docs/I18N.md directs.

observations.note: fr uses 'Esc' here. The catalogue is already split: three hint labels use 'Échap' (common.forms.editable_field.cancel_escape, chat.composer.cancel_recording_hint, chat.composer.stop_work_hint) and three settings sentences use 'Esc annule'. This new sentence follows the settings-sentence pattern, so it is accepted; if fr standardises on 'Échap' later, change the six together rather than this one alone.

hi renders the added classifier as 'सेक्शन' (also in move_to_more_note), while ui.chat.sidebar_view.sections uses 'खंड'. English has no 'section' word in either key, both Hindi words are current, and 'और सेक्शन' reads naturally in a menu; recorded for the next hi terminology pass, not as a defect.

Width: the largest target-to-English deltas are ru reset_layout 36 cells vs 20, fr save_failed 61 vs 34, ur move_to_more_note 40 vs 21, and fr move_up 21 vs 7. None is a visible sidebar row label: more_waiting/more_working and row_actions are aria-labels, move_up/move_down/move_to_more/show_in_sidebar/reset_layout are dropdown menu items, the *_note keys and drag_armed are live-region text, and save_failed is a toast. No destination-row width budget is affected; the menu and toast should still be looked at in the rendered pass.

RTL pass: every ur sentence ends with '۔' and uses '،' commas; the only Latin run is 'Esc', which the render layer isolates per glossary section 3. No punctuation placed inside a placeholder, no direction-sensitive token and no parenthesis reordering.

ur keeps 'Agent Hub' in Latin in both ui.shell and ui.command_palette, consistent with hub.skills.public_hub ('عوامی Agent Hub') and with how fr/es/zh-CN keep Team Bridge in English. The English title-case change therefore needs no ur byte change.

verdict: ui.shell: passed for all seven locales (43 keys each; 14 new keys verified for placeholders, ICU categories, register and glossary terms, 29 pre-existing keys re-read for consistency). ui.command_palette: passed for all seven locales (75 keys each; the Agent Hub case change is consistent with each locale's own rendering and with the other namespaces). Overall: clean - 826 translated values read, 0 blocker, 0 major, 0 minor, 0 nit. The five observations are notes, not defects.
